nodes.description: Owned.owner: address of the current contract owner, written in the Owned constructor and in acceptOwnership.
Owned.newOwner: pending owner set by transferOwnership and cleared in acceptOwnership.
FZB.symbol token ticker, set once in the constructor.
FZB.name token name, set once in the constructor.
FZB.decimals token precision, set once in the constructor.
FZB._totalSupply total minted supply; reduced by burn.
FZB.balances mapping(address=>uint) holding token balances, debited and credited by transfer/transferFrom/burn.
FZB.allowed mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) holding ERC20 allowances.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b): checked addition relying on require(c >= a).
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b): checked subtraction relying on require(b <= a).
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b): checked multiplication.
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b): division with require(b > 0).
Owned constructor: assigns msg.sender to the owner state variable (privileged initialisation).
transferOwnership(address _newOwner): onlyOwner, stages a pending owner.
acceptOwnership(): requires msg.sender == newOwner and promotes newOwner to owner.
FZB constructor: sets metadata, mints the whole supply to a fixed address and emits Transfer.
totalSupply(): returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
balanceOf(address tokenOwner): view returning balances[tokenOwner].
transfer(address to, uint tokens): debits the caller with safeSub and credits the recipient with safeAdd.
approve(address spender, uint tokens): overwrites allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): debits from balance and spender allowance via safeSub.
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender): view returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): stores allowance then calls spender's receiveApproval with arbitrary data.
FZB fallback function (payable) that unconditionally reverts, rejecting plain ETH transfers.
transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens): onlyOwner, executes an arbitrary ERC20 transfer with an attacker-supplied contract address.
burn(uint256 _value): onlyOwner, reduces caller balance and _totalSupply with safeSub.
onlyOwner modifier: require(msg.sender == owner) access-control gate used by privileged functions.
msg.sender used as initial owner in the Owned constructor.
msg.sender compared against owner inside the onlyOwner modifier.
msg.sender compared against newOwner in acceptOwnership.
msg.sender used as the source account in transfer.
msg.sender used as the allowance owner in approve.
msg.sender used as the spender key when debiting allowances in transferFrom.
msg.sender used as the allowance owner and as the from argument of the external receiveApproval call.
msg.sender used as the burner account in burn.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) to an arbitrary user-supplied contract.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an arbitrary user-supplied contract.
Balance arithmetic in transfer: balances[msg.sender] = safeSub(balances[msg.sender], tokens).
Balance/allowance arithmetic in transferFrom via safeSub on balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender].
Access-control check require(msg.sender == owner) performed by the onlyOwner modifier.
Supply arithmetic in burn: balances[burner] = safeSub(...) and _totalSupply = safeSub(_totalSupply, _value).
Parameter 'to' of transfer(address to, uint tokens).
Parameter 'tokens' of transfer(address to, uint tokens), feeds the safeSub subtraction.
Parameter 'from' of transferFrom, used to index balances and allowed without trust assumptions.
Parameter 'to' of transferFrom, credited with safeAdd.
Parameter 'tokens' of transferFrom, feeds the safeSub subtractions.
Parameter 'spender' of approve, indexes the allowed mapping.
Parameter 'tokens' of approve, written into the allowed mapping.
Parameter 'spender' of approveAndCall, used both as allowance key and as the target contract of the external call.
Parameter 'tokens' of approveAndCall, forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
Parameter 'data' of approveAndCall, arbitrary calldata forwarded to the external call.
Parameter 'tokenAddress' of transferAnyERC20Token, attacker-controlled target of the external call.
Parameter 'tokens' of transferAnyERC20Token, forwarded to the external ERC20 transfer.
Parameter '_value' of burn, the amount removed from balance and total supply.
Parameter '_newOwner' of transferOwnership, staged into newOwner.
Local variable 'burner' in burn, holding msg.sender for the balance debit.
